availability_evidence: Ibstock's issuer news archive dates the full-year results statement 3 March 2020; the issuer-hosted PDF carries the same date and complete 2019 primary financial disclosure, and its bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Revenue increased 4.6% to £409.3m and adjusted EBITDA rose 8.8% to £122.3m, or 2.5% excluding IFRS 16. Adjusted profit before tax was broadly stable at £84.8m, while statutory profit declined because the prior year included exceptional disposal gains. Softer second-half demand affected some markets. Adjusted free cash flow fell to £33.2m from £53.3m, cash conversion fell to 59% from 75% and net debt increased to £84.9m from £48.4m, largely reflecting inventory rebuilding and capital investment; leverage remained low at 0.7x.
already_announced_exclusion: The disclosed commercial-function reorganisations, maintenance and capital-enhancement programmes, Longley integration and Atlas factory investment were announced or underway before cutoff and are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Softer demand and weaker cash conversion create contained operating and cash pressure. Revenue and adjusted EBITDA growth, stable adjusted profit, low leverage and continued dividends provide very strong contrary evidence; disclosed organisational and investment actions are excluded.
